meaning: A producer assessed a named session snapshot and documentary dossier. Facts remain agent_asserted; this profile does not attest to diagnosis truth, test execution, or coverage.

provenance.updateRule: Explicit new profile revision and vendored digest; never import live rules.

advance.order: phase order, not tool sequence (optional hypothesis-tracker shares evidence-collection)
advance.next: skip phases with no selected steps; mark skipped; activate next nonempty phase
advance.terminal: complete is done; advancing complete is idempotent

skip.wrapper: Only a phase with no selected steps is skipped. Runtime-inspection is empty when conditional insertion is absent.
skip.externalAssessment: Only producer-derived non-applicability counts. An agent-supplied skipped phase is not evidence of completion. All selected mandatory steps before claim-evaluation require producer API completion events.
skip.optional: hypothesis-tracker is present in the sequence but non-mandatory; claim-evaluation is evaluated separately.

phases.scopeChange: reinitialize with validated new keyword, same problem, scope_changed=true; external binding cannot be reassigned

facts.rule: At least one bound structurally valid fact with non-whitespace content. All asserted facts and rejected alternatives retain agent_asserted; no truth or execution attestation.

claim.typeSelection: ECMAScript toLowerCase then first matching unflagged ECMAScript RegExp in detectionPatterns; generic is the fallback, not a regex. No caller type override.

deriveContext.phaseSatisfied: done or skipped; external producer must establish skipped as genuinely empty using frozen sequence
deriveContext.authority: Derived from authoritative snapshot, never free caller flags. These are documentary agent confirmations, not observed execution.

claim.allowed: all requires flags truthy after deriving boolean context
claim.missing: prerequisite names in the selected policy requires order
claim.score: round(satisfied / requires.length * 100); 100 if requires is empty; diagnostic only

consumerOnly.rules: Explicit consumer context checks challenge lifetime, future/evaluation time, freshness, bindings and replay. Codec has no clock.

keyword.normalization: toLowerCase; replace /[^a-z0-9]+/g with hyphen; trim leading/trailing hyphens
keyword.valid: normalized value contains at least one ASCII alphanumeric
keyword.selectionInput: original validated keyword converted to lowercase, before slug normalization

guardrails.order: start root-cause, step-skipping; append conditional groups in order; append architecture, network; deduplicate preserving first occurrence

minimumPredicates.requires: Session exists in authoritative producer storage, with matching identity, audience, project, task and subject digest bound at external creation; a changed binding requires a new session.
Current session revision matches the evaluated revision; positive safe integer.

Producer API completion events cover every selected mandatory step before claim-evaluation in phase order. Producer-derived non-applicable empty phases alone may be skipped. Caller phase arrays are not authority.
At least one bound structurally valid fact with non-whitespace content and agent_asserted origin; hypotheses, unknowns, decisions and rejected entries alone do not count.
Non-whitespace claim recorded with agent_asserted origin in the hashed dossier.
Derive context from the same bound snapshot; frozen text detection selects the claim type, with no caller override; all prerequisites must be satisfied.
Dossier digest, phase findings and assessment derive from one immutable atomic snapshot. A snapshot/evaluation error cannot produce pass.
